knownDeltas: The demo store's fixed 8-city snapshot stands in for Esri's sample layer: OBJECTIDs, names and populations are ours; the feature-set wire shape (objectIdFieldName/geometryType/spatialReference/features) is Esri's.
name: query-where
notes: Scalar where over layer 0 (cities). Five of the eight cities clear two million; replay pins the matched OBJECTID set in catalogue order with returnGeometry=false.
source: Esri REST docs: Query (Feature Service/Layer) (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/query-feature-service-layer-.htm); where-clause pattern
